status: Unexecuted development diagnostic; not paid authorization or final benchmark protocol
question: Does supplying shared parsing metadata change direct LLM agreement with declared retail policies, relative to raw source cells and authored code?

cohort.source: Existing pinned5000 consumed development rows only
cohort.selection: For each exact numeric source row_id string, hash UTF8(seed + newline + row_id); select24 lowest SHA256 digests, ties by numeric row_id. Freeze selected IDs before new model outputs.
cohort.limitations: Already consumed development data, not fresh or representative. Outcome-independent selection may include few violations and no unknowns; report support instead of claiming high detection performance. Do not replace selected rows to improve metrics.
cohort.heldout: Existing610 evaluation rows remain untouched; this pilot does not consume or label them

conditions.raw_direct: Original scalar cells plus the same policy text, source definitions, normalization specification, mapping specification and output schema; no computed normalized_rows
conditions.metadata_direct: Identical input plus normalized_rows from the shared mapper; no policy verdicts or reference labels
conditions.authored_python: Existing deterministic code on the same selected rows, not a generated-code arm
conditions.authored_shacl: Reuse saved full-development row-graph outputs for the same selected keys; label reused trace, do not count as a fresh execution or assign inherited full-run latency to these rows

generation.exact_model: Pending current availability/pricing verification and separate launch review
generation.messages: Separate independent one-row requests; same wording/settings in the two LLM conditions except normalized_rows
generation.settings: Freeze exact model/provider routing/temperature/output-token limit and supported seed before launch; do not assume deterministic generation
generation.condition_order: Alternate raw-first and metadata-first by selected-row position, single sequential request at a time
generation.cost_ceiling: Not set or authorized. Verify per-call conservative reservation and set a campaign ceiling before requesting paid launch; existing balance is not authorization. Preserve consumed failures.

evaluation.primary_unit: row-policy decision;72 planned decisions per condition, clustered within24rows
evaluation.reference: Separate existing declared-policy scorer module, created after IDs/messages/settings are frozen; references never enter prompts or runtime
measures: violation precision/recall/F1 with undefined denominators shown
paired raw-versus-metadata disagreement by row and policy
reported cost, conservative reservations, request latency
evaluation.paired_reporting: Retain both outputs and classify improved/worsened/unchanged/failed; do not treat three policies on one row as independent model trials
evaluation.claims: Development diagnostic only, not evidence of RDF superiority, general Korean-language performance or retailer business truth
evaluation.source_unknowns: Unknown outcomes reflect missing or unparseable required evidence under the declared policy, distinct from model abstention

Verify exact model/settings and reserve bounded current paid scope
Review complete request runner and failures/cost logging
Review source-only inputs versus scorer-only references
